peter-the-greats-grand-embassy: Travelling half-incognito, the tsar works as a ship's carpenter in Zaandam and Amsterdam to learn Western shipbuilding.
first-telegraph-message: "What hath God wrought" — sent by Samuel Morse from Washington to Baltimore.
ellis-island-opens: Over the next 62 years, about 12 million immigrants pass through its halls.
rescue-of-the-danish-jews: Danes ferry about 7,200 Jews across the Øresund to neutral Sweden in a few weeks.
indian-independence-and-partition: British India is split into India and Pakistan; up to 15 million people are displaced and hundreds of thousands killed.
